transfer.title: Internal transfer
transfer.hint: Moves money between the store’s own accounts. It is not income or an expense, and the store’s total balance does not change.
transfer.reversePrompt: Reverse this whole transfer (both accounts). Reason:

cash.retiredHint: Card and EBT are retired: this balance and its history stay as they are. Nothing new can be recorded here — move a remaining balance with an internal transfer if needed.

teamPeople.title: Financial Personnel
teamPeople.hint: People responsible for paying, receiving or transferring money who are neither employees nor partners. They can be chosen on Income transactions. They get no payroll; a login is optional and only the Store Admin can create it.
teamPeople.name: Name
teamPeople.deactivateHint: Deactivated Financial Personnel can no longer be chosen, but old transactions keep their name.
teamPeople.deleteExplain: {name} will no longer be selectable on new transactions. If {name} is named on any existing transaction or transfer, the record is archived instead of removed, so that history keeps showing the name. No money moves and no transaction changes.
teamPeople.archivedDone: {name} is named on {transactions} transaction(s) and {transfers} transfer(s), so the record was archived instead of removed. History keeps the name; {name} can no longer be selected.
teamPeople.createAccountHint: Creates a login through the email invite: the person receives a link and sets their own password. They can view the Income page and only do what you tick below, on the accounts of their branch. They are never an employee and never get payroll.
teamPeople.emailHint: The invite link is sent here. It must not belong to another login.
teamPeople.branchHint: They can only use the accounts of this branch.
teamPeople.capabilitiesHint: Nothing is allowed until you tick it. Corrections, Admin Exceptions, payroll and settings are never available to this login.
teamPeople.inviteSent: The account was created and an invite email was sent to set the password.
teamPeople.inviteFailed: The account was created, but the invite email could not be sent. Use “Resend invite” later.
